title: Adoption of Physical Measurement Maps, Spectroscopic Rank Resolution, and Macro-Model Isolation
decision: Formalized preflight reconciliation of PCr energy capacity (dG_ATP=54 kJ/mol for work vs dH_CK=21 kJ/mol for heat); downgraded Andersen & Saltin 1985 resting values to secondary literature extrapolations (5 male participants confirmed, not 8); adopted Table 2 published motor unit discharge characteristics (Hug 2021: GM 8.1, 8.1, 7.6, 12.2 Hz; GL 8.1, 8.2, 11.3, 14.0 Hz); classified biological participant count of reused Hug recordings as UNKNOWN; enforced strict separation between rater operators and subjects; prohibited concluding >99% oxidative contribution solely from single-muscle static PCr buffer ratio; and maintained TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED with strict NO_GO on biological interventions.
rationale: Results and scientific validity corrections of Research Cycle 8 (EXP-0032..0036).

title: Adoption of Multi-Modal HD-sEMG Recruitment Model, Downgrade of Andersen & Saltin 1985 Resting Table, and Enforcement of Cross-Muscle Transfer Barrier
decision: Formalized preflight reconciliation of PCr energy capacity (dG_ATP=54 kJ/mol for work vs dH_CK=21 kJ/mol for heat); downgraded Andersen & Saltin 1985 resting values to secondary literature extrapolations; adopted high-density EMG motor unit decomposition and adipose morphometry as mandatory conditions for active volume identifiability; and maintained TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED with strict NO_GO on biological interventions.
rationale: Scalar sEMG RMS has a >40-fold uncertainty span and inverts during fatigue; cross-muscle transfer degrades prediction RMSE by up to 189%; and calf PCr buffer accounts for <0.1% of a 2700 s whole-body endurance budget.

title: Scientific Freeze and Corrigendum of Rehman 2024 N=1 Empirical Benchmark: Reclassification of M2, M3 Blocked Status, Retraction of Universal pH >= 6.86, Separation of Conditional Reconstruction vs Prospective Prediction, and Preservation of TARGET-CPE45 Freeze
decision: Enacted EXP-0042 Scientific Corrigendum and scientific freeze on the Rehman et al. 2024 primary 31P-MRS benchmark: (1) Numerically reconciled all report values and markdown tables with canonical rehman2024_validation_results.json (PCr at 90s: 1920, 1291, 1277; nadir PCr: 1670, 1245, 1231; in-sample RMSE: M0=230.88/120.21/141.69, M1=26.05/15.73/14.70, M2=31.72/37.67/32.80; M0 R2 strictly negative); (2) Reclassified M2 from physiological bioenergetic ODE to CONSTRAINED_MONOEXPONENTIAL_BASELINE, barring claims of validated energy balance, O2 transport, ATP turnover, or motor control; (3) Classified full physiological model M3 as M3_NOT_EXECUTABLE_ON_AVAILABLE_OBSERVATIONS due to absence of mechanical workload, torque, muscle PCSA, and hemodynamics; (4) Distinguished Scenario A (CONDITIONAL_TRAJECTORY_RECONSTRUCTION, accepted with within-subject transfer M2 mean R2 = 0.8566) from Scenario B (PROSPECTIVE_PREDICTION, blocked as PROSPECTIVE_PREDICTION_BLOCKED_UNOBSERVED_DEPLETION_DYNAMICS); (5) Classified nominal timing (48s, 90s) as INFERRED_TIMING_ASSUMPTION and nadir as OBSERVED_SPECTRAL_MINIMUM_DISTINCT_FROM_MECHANICAL_STOP, retracting ischemic/hyperemic labels without blood flow measurements; (6) Formally retracted universal non-acidosis claim pH >= 6.86 as superseded (calculated range 6.7932 to 7.0228, Trial 1 min pH = 6.7932), retaining PH_CALIBRATION_PARTIAL without empirical fudge factors; (7) Strictly prohibited cross-subject Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) on N=1 cohort; (8) Preserved TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED with strict NO_GO on biological interventions.
rationale: Rigorous scientific integrity requires byte-for-byte reconciliation of reports with canonical data, honest mathematical classification of simplified recovery models, formal designation of unexecutable physiological components, and transparent retraction of unverified physiological claims (non-acidosis, ischemic lag) without empirical fudge factors.

title: Cycle 10 Multi-Subject Benchmark Adoption: Adoption of PhysioNet ACTES Cycloergometer (N=18) for Macroscopic Aerobic Coupling Validation, Integration of Allometric Mass Scaling, Ratification of REMAINING_BARRIERS_MATRIX, and Maintenance of TARGET-CPE45 and Biological Interventions Freeze
decision: Formally adopted the PhysioNet ACTES Cycloergometer dataset (SRC-0073, DOI 10.13026/2qs3-kh43, N=18 adolescent athletes, 52,062 synchronized records) as the primary multi-subject cardiorespiratory benchmark for SUBJECT-01: (1) Validated macroscopic aerobic coupling (P_mech -> pulmonary VO2) and Phase II response kinetics (tau = 35 s) under strict Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) cross-validation with frozen parameters, achieving out-of-sample R2 = 0.7371 +/- 0.1770 with body-mass allometric scaling; (2) Overcame the N=1 single-subject bottleneck of Rehman 2024; (3) Ratified REMAINING_BARRIERS_MATRIX, formalizing that macroscopic VO2 does NOT identify or validate localized intracellular phosphates ([PCr], [Pi], [ATP]), cytosolic pH, motor unit recruitment order, or quadriceps PCSA; (4) Maintained TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED; (5) Maintained biological interventions as strictly NO_GO.
rationale: Multi-subject experimental validation breaks the single-subject limitation while maintaining rigorous epistemic boundaries preventing unjustified claims of microscopic intracellular model validation.

title: Cycle 11 Multi-Modality CPET Expansion: Adoption of Factorial Model Nomenclature, Rectification of Efficiency Identifiability Statuses, Adoption of Malaga Treadmill Benchmark (N=992 tests, N=857 subjects), and Ratification of Cross-Modality Transfer Barrier (NEG-0037)
decision: Formally ratified the scientific and metrological updates of Cycle 10/11: (1) Adopted standardized macroscopic factorial model nomenclature (M0 Null Mean -> M1 Static Linear without Mass -> M2 Static Linear with Mass -> M3 Dynamic First-Order ODE -> M4 Allometric Dynamic First-Order ODE); (2) Rectified parameter identifiability definitions: established that linear regression slope beta1 identifies incremental delta efficiency (eta_delta = 1 / (beta1 * 348.33)), while gross efficiency eta_gross(t) = P(t) / E_met(t) is workload-dependent (0% at rest to ~24% at peak) and cannot be equated to slope beta1; verified Phase II delay tau via nested subject-level CV (tau = 35 s); documented metrological discrepancy between PhysioNet ACTES HTML (mL/min) and raw CSV bytes (L/min); documented heterogeneous linear mass scaling degradation in 7/18 subjects; (3) Adopted the PhysioNet Malaga Treadmill CPET dataset (SRC-0074, DOI 10.13026/7ezk-j442, N=992 tests, N=857 subjects, 575,087 observations) as the independent locomotion benchmark: 5-fold cross-validation confirms cardiorespiratory kinetics generalizability (M4 R2 = 0.6712, RMSE = 404.5 mL/min); (4) Empirically confirmed substrate oxidation and the oxycaloric equivalent distribution (mean c_ox = 21.37 kJ/L O2, matching the nominal 20.9 kJ/L assumption within 2.26%); (5) Ratified negative result NEG-0037 establishing the cross-modality barrier (cycling efficiency parameters do not transfer directly to running locomotion without biomechanical locomotion modeling); (6) Maintained TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED and biological interventions strictly NO_GO.
rationale: Ensures mathematical precision in efficiency terminology, guards against test leakage via nested CV, expands empirical cardiorespiratory validation to whole-body running locomotion across 857 participants, and establishes modality specificity boundaries.

title: Cycle 11 Scientific Corrigendum: Subject-Level GroupKFold Validation, Efficiency Identifiability Rectification, Oxycaloric Audit, and Ad-Hoc Cross-Modality Reclassification
decision: Formally ratified the Cycle 11 scientific corrigendum and subject-level validation requirements: (1) Replaced test-level random splitting with deterministic GroupKFold(groups=subject_id, n_splits=5) for the PhysioNet Malaga treadmill dataset (N=846 unique independent participants, N=981 valid incremental tests), guaranteeing intersection(train_subjects, val_subjects) == empty_set across all folds; retained legacy test-level split as an explicit benchmark labeled SUBJECT_LEAKAGE_RISK_NOT_GROUPED; (2) Corrected apparent delta efficiency arithmetic in ACTES: population slope beta1 = 0.007657 L/min/W yields apparent unlagged ramp slope eta_apparent = 1 / (beta1 * 348.33) ~ 37.49% (NOT 25.5%); formally established that true steady-state delta efficiency is DELTA_EFFICIENCY_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_FROM_UNLAGGED_RAMP because ACTES lacks multi-stage constant-load steady states; (3) Reclassified NEG-0037 as AD_HOC_CROSS_MODAL_MAPPING_FAILURE while preserving the empirical error of the formula, and classified physical cross-modal transfer as PHYSICAL_CROSS_MODAL_TRANSFER_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE due to lack of measured running mechanical power in treadmill CPET; (4) Audited oxycaloric equivalent: classified VO2, VCO2, RER as MEASURED, c_ox as DERIVED_MODEL_DEPENDENT, and non-steady-state substrate oxidation as NOT INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATED; established that 46.8% RER > 1 reflects non-metabolic respiratory buffering, not carbohydrate oxidation > 100%; (5) Logged open issue ISS-0020 tracking the license divergence between packaged CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and PhysioNet Health Data License 1.5.0; (6) Maintained TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED and biological interventions strictly NO_GO.
rationale: Eliminates biological group leakage in multi-test CPET cohorts, corrects mathematical calculations in efficiency parameters, rectifies epistemic classifications of indirect calorimetry under non-steady-state exercise, and enforces physical identifiability boundaries.
